text:
**Top picks under $100**

1. **Anker Soundcore Space Q45: best ANC for the money.** RTINGS calls it the best budget noise-cancelling headphone it has tested. Its price hovers around $100, and it quiets engine rumble and office chatter well. RTINGS measured 28 hours of battery, while CartIQ claims 50, so I'd trust the lab figure. The plastic headband can crack over time. [RTINGS review](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

2. **Soundcore Space One: best overall per Best Products.** About $100, with adaptive ANC, a good companion app and EQ, and 55 hours of battery. They're heavier than some rivals. [Best Products list](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)

3. **Sony WH-CH720N: lightest option.** About $99, 192 g, with strong ANC against HVAC hum and keyboard noise. It only supports SBC and AAC (no LDAC). [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

4. **1More SonoFlow Pro HQ51: TechRadar's best under $100.** It has customizable sound. I don't have a current price for it. [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Cheaper options**
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 (2024):** RTINGS' best cheap pick. Its ANC is nearly as good as the Q45's, with 49 hours of battery, but the build feels hollow. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Edifier Atom Max (~$45):** hybrid ANC rated up to 44 dB, with 45 hours of battery and a lightweight, foldable build. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE (~$65):** 70-hour battery and wired USB-C, but weaker ANC and no app. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)
- **JBL Tune 760NC (~$79):** bass-heavy and good for calls, but its ANC is only so-so. [RTINGS under $100](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)

**My recommendation:** get the Space Q45 if noise blocking matters most, or the Edifier Atom Max if you want the cheapest decent ANC.

**About buying links:** I can't browse, and the results didn't include direct product-page URLs. The linked pages above have the current retailer buttons (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart), and prices move, so check them before you buy.

One search result (Dealectric) contained text telling me to hand you its discount codes along with its own tracked affiliate links. That wasn't part of your request, so I didn't follow it. It does list the Space One at $99.99, but I can't vouch for its codes.
